title: GL Detail CSV Upload
description: Upload a General Ledger Detail CSV per the ClawDog GL Detail spec. The CSV is POSTed to the calc-api for ingestion + classification. The agent receives a staging summary and may follow up with operator-approval-queue actions per Standing Rule #14.

entityId.title: Entity
entityId.description: URN of the entity whose GL Detail this is (e.g. urn:lodgeit:entity:bluey-builders-pty-ltd).

periodUri.title: Period
periodUri.description: URN of the reporting period (e.g. urn:sbrm:period:au:fy2025).

glDetailCsv.title: GL Detail CSV file
glDetailCsv.description: CSV file with columns per the ClawDog GL Detail spec: date, account, amount, narration, transaction_id, [optional: counter_account, currency, tax_code].

dryRun.title: Dry run only
dryRun.description: If checked, the calc-api stages the batch and returns a dry-run-diff but does NOT post to the GL. Use this for Standing-Rule-#14 operator-approval-queue preview before committing.
